description: This file defines the NationalitySearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM project, extending the base FilterParams class. It specifies allowed sort fields and sets a default sort field for searching filter parameters related to nationalities.

classes.name: NationalitySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object extending FilterParams, tailored for nationality search filtering, with predefined allowed sort fields and default sort criteria.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'n.name'.
